info.name: BackupDAV
info.summary: Read-only WebDAV export of all users' files for rclone backups
info.description: Exposes every user's personal files and every group folder through one read-only WebDAV endpoint, /remote.php/backupdav/, authenticated by a single service secret managed with occ (backupdav:credentials:generate, backupdav:enable). Built for rclone. Files are read through the Nextcloud Files API, so S3 primary storage works.
info.author: Soluce Technologies
